text:
68세 남성 환자, suspected acute bowel obstruction으로 입원함.

BP 98/60 mmHg.
HR 112 bpm.
RR 24 breaths/min.
BT 37.8°C.
SpO2 95% on room air.

Severe abdominal pain 호소함.

Morphine 4 mg IV q4h 적용함.

NG tube로 nasogastric decompression 시행함.

8시간 동안 urine output 감소 확인됨.

환자 drowsy 상태임.

Surgical team notify함.
